selected_evidence.requirement: Grow the LV to at least 2 GB while mounted and preserve its contents
selected_evidence.summary: Shows /srv/data mounted immediately before and after online extension, exact LV size of 2,147,483,648 bytes, successful XFS growth, and unchanged checksum/content.

Captures the healthy baseline with boot ID 603ea73f-..., restart acknowledgement, changed boot ID 074fc357-..., and full recovery: system running, zero failed units, writable loop PV, active 2 GiB LV, mounted XFS filesystem, and intact data checksum.

commands.command:
set -eu
sudo tee /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-loop-setup >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_SCRIPT'
#!/bin/sh
set -eu
IMAGE=/var/lib/srv-data-pv.img
LOOP=$(/usr/sbin/losetup -j "$IMAGE" | /usr/bin/cut -d: -f1 | /usr/bin/head -1)
if [ -n "$LOOP" ] && [ "$(/usr/sbin/blockdev --getro "$LOOP")" -ne 0 ]; then
  /usr/sbin/losetup -d "$LOOP"
  LOOP=
fi
if [ -z "$LOOP" ]; then
  /usr/sbin/losetup --find --read-write "$IMAGE"
fi
/usr/bin/udevadm settle
/usr/sbin/pvscan --cache >/dev/null
/usr/sbin/vgchange -ay vg_srv >/dev/null
ANTRIEB_SCRIPT
sudo chmod 0755 /usr/local/sbin/srv-data-loop-setup
sudo tee /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service >/dev/null <<'ANTRIEB_UNIT'
[Unit]
Description=Attach persistent loop device for /srv/data LVM PV
After=systemd-remount-fs.service systemd-udev-settle.service local-fs-pre.target
Before=local-fs.target

[Service]
Type=oneshot
ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-loop-setup
RemainAfterExit=yes

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemctl reenable srv-data-loop.service
sudo systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service /etc/systemd/system/srv-data.mount
sudo vgchange -an vg_srv
sudo losetup -d /dev/loop0
sudo systemctl restart srv-data-loop.service
LOOPDEV=$(sudo losetup -j /var/lib/srv-data-pv.img | cut -d: -f1)
printf 'loop_device=%s read_only=' "$LOOPDEV"
sudo blockdev --getro "$LOOPDEV"
sudo systemctl reset-failed srv-data.mount
sudo systemctl start srv-data.mount
systemctl is-active srv-data-loop.service srv-data.mount
findmnt -no SOURCE,FSTYPE,SIZE,AVAIL,TARGET /srv/data
sudo sha256sum /srv/data/preservation-proof.txt

[Unit]
Description=Attach persistent loop device for /srv/data LVM PV
DefaultDependencies=no
After=systemd-remount-fs.service systemd-udev-settle.service
Before=local-fs.target shutdown.target
Conflicts=shutdown.target

[Service]

ExecStart=/usr/local/sbin/srv-data-loop-setup

[Install]
WantedBy=local-fs.target
ANTRIEB_UNIT
sudo systemctl daemon-reload
sudo systemd-analyze verify /etc/systemd/system/srv-data-loop.service /etc/systemd/system/srv-data.mount
